raw_sections.skills:
Technical Profile
➢ Languages & Scripts: Java (8/11/17), J2EE, SQL, NoSQL, PL/SQL, JavaScript.
➢ Frameworks & Architecture: Microservices, Spring Boot, Spring Batch, MVC, Restful, JPA, JSP.
➢ Messaging & Caching: Apache Kafka, Redis, MeghaCache (Walmart).
➢ Event Driven and Concurrency: K8s Cronjobs, Spring Scheduling Cron, ExecuterService.
➢ Databases: NoSQL – (MongoDB, CosmosDB), SQL (SQL Server, Oracle, MySQL), PL/SQL.
➢ Cloud & DevOps: Jenkins, Docker, Kubernetes k8s, Azure (Storage Blob, CosmosDb, SQL Server),
AWS (S3, IAM, SNS, Lambda), WCNP (CI/CD, K8s, Dxconsole).
➢ Web Development: Restful Web Services, ReactJs , JSP, HTML, CSS, JavaScript, AJAX, JQuery.
➢ Logging, Alerts & Metrics: Log4j, Splunk, K8 Dashboard, Grafana.
➢ Tools & IDEs: IntelliJ, Eclipse, VS Code, SQL Developer, Jira, Postman, Maven.
➢ Operating Systems: Windows, Unix, Ubuntu.
Strengths: Analytical thinker, dependable team player, excellent communicator
raw_sections.experience:
Professional Experience
Senior Software Engineer | Ascendion for Client Walmart (Sep 2021 – Apr 2025)
Projects: Walmart Translation Platform (WTP), Content Translation Engine (CTE), Massmart Item & Catalogue.
Developed scalable backend microservices in Java (8–17), Spring Boot, Batch, JPA, Cronjobs, Apache Kafka, Redis.
Used Azure CosmosDb and Azure Storage for data persistence.
Built event driven stack cronjobs for scheduling jobs, Redis and Meghacache to optimized and cached the data.
Built message driven architecture using Apache Kakfka
Delivered multi-language support features and catalog management in e-commerce systems.

Integrations and migration of legacy projects in spring boot microservices, vulnerability & codes optimizations.
Senior Software Engineer | Smart Food Safe Solution Inc. (May 2020 – Aug 2021)
Projects: Smart Farm & IAM
Developed full-stack features using ReactJS, NodeJS, Spring Boot, MongoDB, AWS.

Enhanced farm management portals for growers and agronomists.
Developed cross-platform Smart Farm App to run on multiple devices and platform (ios, android, web).
•
Integrated UI/UX using Material-UI and supported backend APIs via Spring and NodeJs.
Senior Software Engineer | Marlabs Software Pvt Ltd (May 2019 – May 2020)
Projects: PAXIA IFX (Inflight Exchange) – SaaS for airline/rail onboard services.

Full-stack development with JSP, ReactJS, Spring Boot, JPA, Oracle.

Enabled dynamic reporting, service insights, and performance analytics.

Integrated UI/UX using Material-UI and supported backend APIs via Spring.
Associate Technical Lead | Zycus Infotech Pvt Ltd (Aug 2017 – May 2019)
Projects: iSupplier – Procurement Domain
Development of supplier onboarding and self-service portals.

Full-stack development with JSP, Spring Boot, JPA, MongoDB, SQL Server, Jenkins.
Streamlined DB performance by eliminating redundant queries
Streamlined latency by eliminating duplicate and multiple DB calls, refactoring of code efficiency.
Associate Software Engineer | Vmoksha Technologies Pvt Ltd (May 2015 – June 2017)
Projects: VT-Plus – Telecom Domain.

Full-stack development for enhancement feature using web technologies like- JSP, Javascript, Jquery, Json, css,
xml, Spring MVC, Oracle, Jenkins.
Built cronjobs, applied reactive programming, and optimized caching layers.

Implementations of modules for a dynamic pages and configuration screens based on the number of devices and
verticals plan selections.
Handle and manage billing modules based on the selections of various plans and schemes for the users.
